arr.description: array object into which values will be inserted.
constraints: arr, obj, and values must be compatible in shape and dtype for insertion
if axis is None, arr will be flattened before insertion

obj.description: slice or array of indices specifying insertion locations.
constraints: arr, obj, and values must be compatible in shape and dtype for insertion

values.description: array of values to be inserted.
constraints: arr, obj, and values must be compatible in shape and dtype for insertion

axis.description: specify the insertion axis in the case of multi-dimensional arrays. If unspecified, ``arr`` will be flattened.
constraints: must be a valid axis index if int is provided
if axis is None, arr will be flattened before insertion

output.description: A copy of ``arr`` with values inserted at the specified locations.

constraints: arr, obj, and values must be compatible in shape and dtype for insertion
if axis is None, arr will be flattened before insertion
